summary: Squared Euclidean distance between two 3D vectors: computes the per-component differences a1[i] - a2[i] for i in 0..2 and returns the sum of their squares as a double. Pure scalar math routine with no guards, globals or calls.

operations.description: Compute the x difference v3 = a1[0] - a2[0], reading the first float of the vector at this+0x0.
Compute the y difference v2 = a1[1] - a2[1], reading the component at this+0x4.
Compute the z difference v4 = a1[2] - a2[2], reading the component at this+0x8.
Square each difference and sum them: v3*v3 + v2*v2 + v4*v4.
Return the squared 3D distance as a double.

clean_pseudocode: return v3 * v3 + v2 * v2 + v4 * v4;
